title: Surfaces India card mandates on Charges and SetupIntents even when inactive
summary: Changes the following properties for India recurring card payments so that they return the mandate ID even when registration fails and the mandate is inactive: If your integration treats a non-null payment_method_details.card.mandate property on a Charge or mandate property on a SetupIntent as confirmation that the mandate is usable, you must update it to check the mandate’s status. Attempting a subsequent off-session payment with an inactive mandate causes the payment to fail.
migrationNotes: Before using a returned mandate for a subsequent off-session payment, retrieve it and verify that its status is active. You can also use an inactive mandate’s ID to identify a failed registration and show the failure to your customer. See Mandate webhooks for integration guidance.

sources.quote: | [Surfaces India card mandates on Charges and SetupIntents even when inactive](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/surface-india-card-mandate-even-when-inactive.md) | Payments | Breaking | api |

If your integration treats a non-null `payment_method_details.card.mandate` property on a Charge or `mandate` property on a SetupIntent as confirmation that the mandate is usable, you must update it to check the mandate’s status. Attempting a subsequent off-session payment with an `inactive` mandate causes the payment to fail.
